en-US.description: East Money's professional intelligent financial data terminal.
en-US.longDescription: Choice is an intelligent financial data brand under East Money. The Choice financial data terminal serves financial investment institutions, academic research institutions, government regulators, media, and professional investors with multi-scenario financial data services, covering market data, fundamental data, research reports, and quantitative tools for markets such as Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing, Hong Kong, and the United States, helping users reach more efficient and more precise investment decisions.

zh-CN.description: 东方财富旗下专业的智能金融数据终端。
zh-CN.longDescription: Choice数据是东方财富旗下智能金融数据品牌。Choice智能金融终端面向金融投资机构、学术研究机构、政务监管、媒体和专业投资者，提供金融投资领域的多场景数据服务，涵盖沪深京、港股、美股等市场的行情数据、基本面数据、资讯研报与量化工具，帮助用户获得更高效、更精准的投资决策依据。
zh-CN.name: Choice
zh-CN.publisher: 上海奇思信息技术有限公司
